title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 24. Demands that the necessary human resources be provided to the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre (ECCC)which is key to countering the growing hybrid threats posed by the Russian Federation, to ensure it can fully deliver on its mandate in the evolving geopolitical context in light of the fact that adequate staffing is essential to ensure its critical functions are effectively carried out;
